name: Brand of Nurgle
description: (Tag:poison+)(Tag:poison-resistance+)(Tag:talent)You wear the brand of Nurgle, the Plague Father, making you immune to poisons, toxins, and diseases below Legendary rank and greatly resistant above it. You understand poisons, toxins, and diseases better, increasing related ability potency and your power to cure them. Note: Brands do not connect you to the Chaos Gods or Warp.
